newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay shares seen soft, eye crucial UF meeting.
newsitem.headline: Bombay shares seen soft, eye crucial UF meeting.

text.p: ** (0400 GMT) Bombay shares seen drifting as political
overhang continues to weigh on market, traders say
** Market eyes ruling United Front (UF) coalition's core
committee meeting Thursday to thrash out nagging issues
** Foreign funds cautious in making fresh commitments as
share prices seen in corrective phase
** Local factors may overshadow Dow Jones record close
